standard.summary: 推荐第二步尝试。交换 U-Net middle block
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Recommended as the second thing to try. Swaps the U-Net middle block
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 推荐第二步尝试。交换 U-Net middle block，通常仍比较划算，但依然会拖慢训练

advanced_en.principle: Recommended to try second. Swaps the U-Net middle block — usually still worthwhile, but it does slow training.
